title: viscum album subsp. austriacum
intro: Viscum album subsp. austriacum, commonly known as European mistletoe, is a parasitic plant that grows on the branches of various trees, particularly apple trees. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Viscum album subsp. austriacum include antitumor, immunomodulatory, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its use in cancer treatment and management. The bioactive constituents of this plant include viscoalbin, mistletoe lectins (ML-I and ML-II), and other compounds such as polysaccharides, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic properties.
